verdict.rationale: While Asana's evidence pack mentions general AI features (AI Teammates, AI Studio, 'AI Chief of Staff' Dash) and API access to status updates, none of the citations describe an AI capability that drafts a project or initiative status update from recent activity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an AI status-update drafting feature, evidence of it summarizing recent task/activity data, and any hands-on or community confirmation it works.
